title: Giving and Justifying an Opinion (JRE)
summary: إزاي تقول رأيك بالإنجليزي وتثبته بطريقة JRE: رأي واضح، وسبب، ودليل، وربط يقنع اللي سامعك.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: In speaking tasks you are often asked for your opinion. A good spoken opinion is not just "I agree". You must **justify** it: say your position clearly, explain **why**, and support it with **evidence**. The book calls this **JRE: Justify – Reasoning – Evidence**.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن أهم مهارة في الكلام في المنهج كله: إنك **تقول رأيك وتثبته**. مش كفاية تقول «أنا موافق» وتسكت. لازم تقول موقفك بوضوح، وبعدين تقول **ليه**، وبعدين تجيب **دليل** يقنع اللي سامعك.

الكتاب من أول صفحة (المقدمة، **The JRE+ Inquiry Model**) بيقول إن البرنامج كله مبني على الطريقة دي: **J = Justify** (موقفك) و**R = Reasoning** (ليه) و**E = Evidence** (الدليل)، وبيزود عليهم **+ Reflect and Act** (تفكر الكلام ده معناه إيه في الحياة الحقيقية). وفي **Unit 1** الهدف بيقول: *express and justify opinions*، وفي **Unit 2**: *give a structured spoken opinion with reasons*. وكل وحدة فيها **JRE questions** زي: *To what extent should governments be responsible for the energy transition?* (Unit 5). يعني الدرس ده هتستخدمه في **كل الوحدات**، في الكلام وفي الكتابة كمان.
يعني إيه JRE؟ (بالبلدي)

text: **J** = your clear position (claim). **R** = the reason that explains it. **E** = evidence that proves it (from the text, facts, numbers or real examples), and then you link the evidence back to your claim.

blocks.text: تخيل إنك محامي في محكمة. القاضي مش هيصدقك علشان إنت بتقول «موكلي بريء» وبس. لازم تقول **موقفك** (بريء)، وبعدين **السبب** (كان مسافر ساعتها)، وبعدين **الدليل** (تذكرة الطيارة). هو ده بالظبط الـ JRE:

rows: قول **موقفك** بوضوح في جملة واحدة (claim = ادعاء/رأي)
I strongly believe that… / In my opinion,…
This is because… / The main reason is that…
هات **دليل**: من النص، رقم، مثال حقيقي من مصر أو من حياتك
For example,… / The text shows that… / According to…
explain how it supports my claim
اربط الدليل برأيك تاني (الكتاب بيقول: *explain how it supports my claim*)
This shows that… / This proves that…

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ: أربع كلمات بس
items: **this shows** ← ده الربط اللي بيقفل الكلام.
لو قلت الأربعة دول بالترتيب، إنت عملت إجابة JRE كاملة حتى لو كلامك بسيط.

blocks.text: الدليل (Evidence) بيجي منين؟

text: Evidence must be **relevant** (connected to your claim) and **reliable** (true and from a trustworthy source). Personal feelings alone are not evidence.

blocks.text: أكتر حاجة الطلاب بيغلطوا فيها هي الدليل. «أنا حاسس كده» ده **مش دليل**. الكتاب بيقول لازم تدعم **كل claim** بدليل موثوق من نص أو بحث أو أرقام أو تجربة حقيقية. دي أنواع الدليل اللي تقدر تستخدمها:

rows: The text states that teenagers who sleep less feel more stressed.
أقوى حاجة لو السؤال بيقول *Use evidence from the text*
By 17, teenagers have spent more time on social media than in school.
لما عايز تبين إن المشكلة كبيرة
The Benban Solar Park in Aswan produces clean energy for thousands of homes.
لما السؤال عن مصر أو عن الحلول
Doctors recommend eight to ten hours of sleep for teenagers.
When I deleted one game from my phone, my marks improved.
لما السؤال بيقول *from your own observations*

blocks.title: خلي بالك: الدليل لازم يكون له علاقة
blocks.text: لو بتقول إن الرياضة بتحسن النوم، متجيبش دليل عن إن الرياضة بتجيب فلوس. الدليل لازم يثبت **نفس** الحاجة اللي قلتها في الـ J. وكمان متخترعش أرقام مش متأكد منها: قول *Many studies suggest…* أحسن من رقم غلط.
إزاي تفهم السؤال قبل ما تجاوب؟

text: Different questions need different openings. Read the question word carefully: **To what extent**, **Do you agree**, **Which is more**, **Should**.

blocks.text: كل سؤال ليه «مفتاح». لو فهمت المفتاح هتعرف تبدأ إجابتك صح:

rows: لأي درجة؟ (مش بس آه أو لأ)
I believe that, **to a large extent**,… / **To some extent**,… / **Only to a small extent**,…
I **completely agree** that… / I **partly agree**… / I **disagree** because…
**Which is more effective, A or B?**
In my view, **A is more effective than B** because…
I think schools **should / should not**… because…
There are two main reasons. Firstly,… / One way is to…

items.en: To a large extent, screen time affects teenagers' sleep.
items.ar: لدرجة كبيرة، وقت الشاشات بيأثر على نوم المراهقين. (رد على To what extent)

items.en: I partly agree that sport is the best leisure activity.
items.ar: أنا موافق جزئيًا إن الرياضة أحسن نشاط في وقت الفراغ. (موافقة نص نص)

items.en: In my view, family support is more effective than individual activities for managing stress.
items.ar: في رأيي، دعم الأسرة أنفع من الأنشطة الفردية في التعامل مع التوتر. (اخترت واحدة من الاتنين)

items.en: I strongly believe that shops should donate unsold food.
items.ar: أنا مقتنع جدًا إن المحلات لازم تتبرع بالأكل اللي ما اتباعش. (رأي قوي)

items.en: It seems to me that brands influence teenagers more than parents do.
items.ar: يبدو لي إن الماركات بتأثر على المراهقين أكتر من الأهل. (رأي هادي أقل حدة)

items.en: This is mainly because apps use autoplay to keep users online.
items.ar: ده أساسًا لأن التطبيقات بتشغل الفيديو اللي بعده لوحده علشان تخلي المستخدم أونلاين. (R = السبب)

items.en: For example, the text states that notifications damage concentration.
items.ar: مثلًا، النص بيقول إن الإشعارات بتضر التركيز. (E من النص)

items.en: This shows that reducing notifications could help students study better.
items.ar: ده بيبين إن تقليل الإشعارات ممكن يساعد الطلاب يذاكروا أحسن. (الربط)

blocks.text: درجة قوة رأيك

text: You can make your opinion **strong** (I am convinced that…) or **careful** (It seems that… / This may…). Careful language is called **hedging**. It is useful when the evidence is not 100% certain.

blocks.text: مش لازم كل رأي يبقى ١٠٠٪. لو الدليل قوي قول رأيك بقوة. لو الدليل مش أكيد استخدم كلمات «تهدّي» الرأي زي *may / might / could / it seems*. الكتاب في Unit 1 بيسمي ده **hedging** (يعني تكون حذر في كلامك).

rows: I am convinced that… / There is no doubt that…
I believe that… / In my opinion,…
It seems that… / This may… / I tend to think that…
يبدو إن / ممكن / أميل إني أفكر إن

blocks.text: جمل جاهزة (Useful Phrases)

groups.title: J: قول رأيك (Giving your opinion)
items: As far as I am concerned, …
To a large extent, I agree that …

groups.title: R: السبب (Giving a reason)
items: One reason for this is that …

groups.title: E: الدليل (Giving evidence)
items: A good example of this is …

blocks.text: إجابة نموذجية (Model Answer)
السؤال ده من نوع أسئلة **Unit 1** (social media and identity). دي إجابة شفوية تقولها في حوالي دقيقة. لاحظ إزاي فيها J ثم R ثم E ثم ربط ثم خاتمة:

blocks.title: Model spoken answer: JRE opinion (about 1 minute)
blocks.task: To what extent does social media create unrealistic expectations about lifestyle and identity? Justify your position with reasons and examples.
text: In my opinion, social media creates unrealistic expectations **to a large extent**, especially for teenagers.

This is mainly because people usually post only the best moments of their lives. They choose the perfect photo, add a filter and hide the boring or difficult parts. So when we scroll, we compare our real, ordinary day with someone else's "perfect" day.

For example, the text explains that constant social comparison can make young people feel that their lives are less successful. I have also noticed this among my friends: a classmate of mine felt sad because her weekend did not look as exciting as the trips she saw online.
This shows that the problem is not the app itself but the selected picture it shows us. However, I think we can reduce this effect if we remember that a post is not the whole story.
So, overall, I believe social media does create unrealistic expectations, and we need to use it mindfully.
notes: **J (الجملة الأولى):** رأي واضح وبدرجة (*to a large extent*) لأن السؤال *To what extent*.
**R:** *This is mainly because…* وشرح السبب بخطوات بسيطة (بيختاروا أحلى صورة، فلتر، بيخبوا الجزء الممل).
**E:** دليلين: واحد من النص (*the text explains that…*) وواحد من الملاحظة الشخصية زي ما السؤال طالب (*from your own observations*).
**الربط:** *This shows that…* رجّع الدليل للرأي. وكمان فيه *However* علشان يبين إنه فاكر ناحية تانية.
**الخاتمة:** *So, overall,…* وكرر الرأي بكلام مختلف شوية، واستخدم كلمة من الوحدة (*mindfully*).
الجمل قصيرة وسهلة النطق، ومفيش كلمات صعبة ملهاش لازمة: ده المطلوب في الكلام.

blocks.text: ودي إجابة أقصر (٤ جمل بس) لسؤال من **Unit 1** برضه: *Which is more effective for managing stress: family support or individual activities?*

blocks.title: Short JRE answer (4 sentences)
blocks.task: Which is more effective for managing stress: family support or individual activities?
text: **(J)** I believe that family support is more effective than individual activities for managing stress. **(R)** This is because talking to someone who loves you helps you understand the problem, not just forget it for a while. **(E)** For instance, when I was worried about my exams, my father helped me make a study timetable, and my stress went down. **(Link)** This shows that support from family can solve the cause of stress, while activities like gaming only give a short break.
notes: كل حرف من JRE في جملة لوحده، وده أسهل شكل تحفظه.
استخدم مقارنة (*more effective than*) لأن السؤال *Which is more…*.
الدليل مثال شخصي حقيقي وبسيط، والربط بيرجّع للمقارنة تاني.
الحروف اللي بين الأقواس (J) (R) (E) (Link) علشان توضيح بس، متقولهاش وإنت بتتكلم (عدد الكلمات من غيرها ٧٨ كلمة).

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء
items: ✗ *I agree.* (وتسكت) ← ✓ *I agree that schools should limit phones **because**… For example,…*
✗ *I am agree.* ← ✓ ***I agree.*** (agree فعل، من غير am)
✗ *In my opinion, I think…* ← ✓ ***In my opinion,…*** **أو** ***I think…*** (واحدة بس، الاتنين مع بعض تكرار)
✗ دليل ملوش علاقة بالرأي ← ✓ دليل بيثبت **نفس** الـ claim.
✗ *Because social media is bad.* (جملة ناقصة) ← ✓ *I think social media can be harmful because it wastes time.*
✗ تقرأ من ورقة كلمة كلمة ← ✓ اكتب **كلمات مفتاحية** بس واتكلم بطبيعتك (الكتاب بيقول: *Do not read from a full script*).

blocks.title: إزاي تتكلم بثقة لما يسألك المدرس فجأة؟
items: خد ٥ ثواني تفكر، وقول جملة تكسب بيها وقت: *That's an interesting question.*
قرر موقفك بسرعة (موافق / مش موافق / جزئيًا). متقعدش تتردد.
قول **سبب واحد قوي** أحسن من ٣ أسباب ضعاف.
دايمًا جهز مثال من **مصر** أو من **حياتك** لأي موضوع: ده أسهل دليل تفتكره.
اقفل بجملة: *So, that's why I believe…*

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بأشكال زي دي:
**١) سؤال JRE شفوي أو مكتوب** (موجود في كل وحدة في الهامش تحت كلمة JRE):

text: Do you agree that taking small actions is more effective than waiting for large-scale change? Give evidence to support your claim.

blocks.text: **الحل:** ابدأ بـ *I (partly) agree that…* ← سبب ← دليل (مثلًا حملة تنضيف النيل اللي بدأت بخمس أصحاب وبقت مئات المتطوعين) ← *This shows that…*.
**٢) نشاط Four Corners** (Unit 4): المدرس يقول جملة، وإنت تروح لركن *Strongly agree / Agree / Disagree / Strongly disagree* و**تبرر** اختيارك:

text: "Brands influence teenagers more than parents do." Move and justify your opinion.

blocks.text: **الحل:** *I agree, because teenagers spend hours on social media where brands advertise all the time. For example, many of my friends want a certain brand of trainers only because famous influencers wear them. This shows that brands can sometimes speak louder than parents.*

**٣) أسئلة المناقشة اللي فيها Evaluate**: زي *Do you think young people can make a real difference in solving the climate crisis? Why or why not?* — كلمة *Why or why not* معناها: لازم سبب، مش آه أو لأ بس.
تدريب
**A) حدد كل جملة: J ولا R ولا E ولا Link؟**

items.q: 1. Vocational schools help students find jobs quickly.
items.a: **J** — ده رأي / claim عايز يتثبت.

items.q: 2. This is because they teach practical skills that employers need.
items.a: **R** — بيقول *ليه*، وبدأ بـ This is because.

items.q: 3. For example, Salma studies hospitality because tourism is important to Egypt's economy.
items.a: **E** — مثال محدد بدأ بـ For example.

items.q: 4. This shows that vocational education is connected to a country's needs.
items.a: **Link** — بيربط الدليل بالرأي (This shows that).

items.q: 5. According to the podcast, the cost of solar panels has fallen a lot in the last decade.
items.a: **E** — دليل من مصدر (According to).

items.q: 6. The main reason is that sport releases stress in a healthy way.
items.a: **R** — سبب (The main reason is that).

blocks.text: **B) Choose the best answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
7. The question is "To what extent…?". The best opening is:
a. Yes, I do.
b. To a large extent, I believe that…
c. Because it is good.
d. I am agree that…
items.a: **b** — To what extent عايزة **درجة**، مش Yes/No. و(d) غلط لأن *I am agree* غلط في الجرامر.

items.q:
8. Which sentence gives **evidence**?
a. I think recycling is important.
b. This is because waste harms the planet.
c. The text states that a third of all food is wasted.
d. So, overall, recycling matters.
items.a: **c** — معلومة من النص (The text states). (a) J و(b) R و(d) خاتمة.

items.q:
9. Which is a **hedged** (careful) opinion?
a. There is no doubt that games are harmful.
b. Games are always harmful.
c. Games may harm some students' concentration.
d. I am convinced games are harmful.
items.a: **c** — كلمة *may* و*some* بيخلوا الرأي حذر.

items.q:
10. "I believe museums should use technology. ______, the GEM uses digital screens to explain ancient objects."
a. However
b. For instance
c. Although
d. Because
items.a: **b** — بعدها مثال، يبقى For instance.

items.q:
11. Which is the best **link** sentence?
a. This shows that technology can make history easier to understand.
b. In my opinion, technology is good.
c. For example, some screens are big.
d. Museums are old.
items.a: **a** — This shows that بترجّع الدليل للرأي.

items.q:
12. "In my opinion, I think fast fashion is harmful." What is wrong?
a. Nothing.
b. It repeats the opinion phrase twice.
c. It needs "am".
d. "Harmful" is a noun.
items.a: **b** — In my opinion و I think نفس المعنى، استخدم واحدة بس.

blocks.text: **C) Put the sentences in the correct JRE order.**

items.q: 13. (a) For example, many families in my street now cook only what they need. (b) I believe food waste can be reduced at home. (c) This shows that small habits make a big difference. (d) This is because people can plan meals before shopping.
items.a: **b – d – a – c** — رأي ← سبب ← مثال ← ربط.

items.q: 14. (a) This is because a hobby gives you a break from pressure. (b) This proves that hobbies support well-being. (c) In my view, every student needs a hobby. (d) For instance, my brother started drawing and now he feels calmer before exams.

15. (a) The text states that birds depend on wetlands during migration. (b) From my perspective, wetlands must be protected. (c) Therefore, losing them would harm many species. (d) The main reason is that they are shared by many living things.
16. Complete with a suitable phrase: "______ that schools should teach mindfulness. ______ it helps students control stress. ______, a short breathing exercise before exams can calm the mind."
items.a: **I strongly believe** that… **This is because** it helps… **For example**, a short breathing… — J ثم R ثم E.

items.q: 17. Correct the mistake: "I am agree that renewable energy is the future, because it is clean."
items.a: **I agree** that renewable energy is the future because it is clean. — agree فعل، من غير am.

blocks.text: **D) Speaking practice: جاوب بصوت عالي في دقيقة باستخدام JRE.** (الإجابة فيها أفكار نموذجية قصيرة تبني عليها)

items.q: 18. (Unit 1) Should schools teach students how to manage their mental health?
items.a: **J:** Yes, I strongly believe they should. **R:** students face exam pressure and social comparison every day. **E:** students who learn simple techniques like breathing or planning feel calmer, and many schools now have counsellors. **Link:** This shows that well-being is a skill that can be taught.

items.q: 19. (Unit 2) Do the benefits of gaming outweigh the risks for young people today?
items.a: **J:** Only to a small extent. **R:** games can improve problem-solving but they are designed to keep players online. **E:** autoplay, rewards and late-night playing reduce sleep. **Link:** So the risks are bigger unless players set clear time limits.

items.q: 20. (Unit 3) Is visiting a museum in person better than a digital tour?
items.a: **J:** I believe visiting in person is better. **R:** you feel the real size and atmosphere of history. **E:** standing in front of the Grand Staircase at the GEM is a unique experience that a screen cannot give. **Link:** This shows that real visits create stronger memories.

items.q: 21. (Unit 4) "Black Friday does more harm than good." Do you agree?
items.a: **J:** I agree. **R:** it encourages impulse buying. **E:** people buy things only because they are on sale, then never use them, and this creates waste. **Link:** This means the short-term saving becomes a long-term cost.

items.q: 22. (Unit 5) Which is more effective in Egypt: government projects or individual actions?
items.a: **J:** In my view, government projects have a bigger impact. **R:** they have more resources and can change whole systems. **E:** the Benban Solar Park in Aswan produces clean energy on a huge scale. **Link:** Individual actions are important, but large projects make change faster.

items.q: 23. (Unit 7) Can a hobby become a career?
items.a: **J:** Yes, to a large extent. **R:** passion makes people practise for years. **E:** someone who loves baking can start by selling to neighbours, then open a small online shop. **Link:** This shows that small steps can turn a hobby into an opportunity.

items.q: 24. (Unit 8) Should more Egyptian students choose vocational education?
items.a: **J:** I think they should. **R:** the job market needs practical skills. **E:** tourism, technology and engineering need trained workers, and vocational schools prepare them directly. **Link:** Therefore, vocational education supports both students and the country.

items.q: 25. (Unit 10) Is fast fashion really cheap?
items.a: **J:** I do not think so. **R:** the low price hides other costs. **E:** factories use a lot of water, and workers are often paid very little. **Link:** This shows that someone else pays the real price of a cheap T-shirt.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: **JRE** = **J** رأيك بوضوح ← **R** السبب (*because*) ← **E** دليل (*For example / The text shows*) ← وربط (*This shows that*).
اقرأ مفتاح السؤال: *To what extent* = درجة، *Do you agree* = موافق ولا لأ، *Which is more* = اختار واحدة.
الدليل لازم يكون **له علاقة** و**موثوق**: من النص، رقم، مثال من مصر، أو ملاحظة حقيقية.
قول *I agree* (مش *I am agree*)، ومتجمعش *In my opinion* و*I think* في جملة واحدة.
اتكلم من **كلمات مفتاحية** مش من ورقة مكتوبة، واقفل دايمًا بجملة خاتمة.
